name: Sleep Reset
one_liner: App-based CBT for insomnia with daily lessons, a sleep diary and 1:1 messaging with a human sleep coach, paid every 28 days.
best_for: Adults with ongoing trouble falling or staying asleep who want a drug-free CBT-I program
People who want a human coach to message rather than an app-only program
People who can use HSA/FSA funds or pay out of pocket
not_for: People with possible untreated sleep apnea, until they have been tested
People who need a doctor to manage sleep medication
Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for a low-cost option: the program costs about $297 every 28 days
short_description: A CBT-I insomnia program in an app: an initial sleep assessment, short daily lessons and a sleep diary, with 1:1 messaging from a sleep coach.
long_description: Sleep Reset is an app-based program built on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I). It starts with a sleep assessment, then gives you short daily lessons and exercises (about 5–10 minutes), a sleep diary, sleep restriction and stimulus-control guidance, meditations and journaling, and 1:1 messaging with a human sleep coach. Sleep Reset's pricing page lists a $19 one-week trial, then $297 every 28 days; the App Store listing shows program purchases of $229.99–$299.99, and the program is HSA/FSA eligible. A 2023 study in Frontiers in Sleep of 564 people who completed the 12-week program found total sleep time rose by about 44 minutes and time awake at night fell by 28 minutes; it had no control group. Sleep Reset says it follows HIPAA for its telehealth services and does not sell personal information, but its App Store privacy label says browsing history is used to track you for advertising.
patient_summary: You take a sleep assessment, then follow short daily CBT-I lessons in the app, keep a sleep diary and message a human sleep coach for guidance. It starts with a $19 one-week trial, then costs $297 every 28 days, and you can pay with an HSA or FSA card. It is a coaching program, not a doctor's visit or medication.

pricing.notes: Cancel any time. HSA/FSA eligible. App Store in-app purchases for the program are listed at $229.99–$299.99. The pricing page does not say insurance covers the program.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell personal information and follows HIPAA for telehealth, but its App Store label says browsing history is used to track you and the policy mentions interest-based advertising.

seo.title: Sleep Reset: CBT-I Insomnia Program with Coaching | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Sleep Reset offers CBT-I for insomnia with real human sleep coaches. Stanford/Yale developed. 85 more minutes of sleep per night. HSA/FSA eligible.

faqs.a: Sleep Reset is a clinically proven CBT-I digital program for insomnia with personalized coaching from real human sleep therapists, developed by Stanford and Yale researchers.
Members report 85 more minutes of sleep per night, 53% less time to fall asleep, 41% less time awake at night, and 2 fewer nightly awakenings, with improvements starting in 2 weeks.

faqs.q: How much does Sleep Reset cost?
faqs.a: Sleep Reset starts with a $19 one-week trial, then $229-$299 for the full program. It's HSA/FSA eligible. At-home apnea testing is $189 and clinician visits are $149.

faqs.q: Does Sleep Reset use real coaches or chatbots?
faqs.a: Sleep Reset uses real human sleep therapists and coaches (not bots) who provide 1:1 messaging support for guidance and accountability throughout your program.

primary_uses: Sleep restriction and stimulus control plans
Daily sleep diary and sleep score

clinical_trials.outcome: Among completers, total sleep time rose about 44 minutes, wake after sleep onset fell 28 minutes and sleep efficiency rose 6.6 points over 12 weeks; no control group.
